The change handles ordinary snapshot subsets and both snapshot representations, but not every network. For stochastic networks, dynamic port efficiencies can have MultiIndex columns for scenarios and component names; `_model_snapshot_array` assumes a single `name` column dimension and calls `values.columns.rename("name")`, which fails for a MultiIndex. Thus the transmission function does not reliably obtain aligned efficiencies for every network.
